name: feature-disclosures
title: Native feature switcher
description: Exclusive browser-native disclosures for feature storytelling without a script.

files.content:
PRODUCT / CAPABILITIES

Explore what each feature does.

Native, exclusive disclosures offer keyboard-accessible content switching without requiring JavaScript. This is an accordion, not an ARIA tabs widget.
